info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description:
Retrieves the audit log report generation status based on the specified report status ID (retrieved from POST /auditlogEntryReport response). You need to continue polling for the report status until a terminal status is reached (e.g., COMPLETE) to download the report subsequently.

To learn more, see Downloading Audit Logs and Event Logs Using API.

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: The status ID for the report obtained from the response of the POST /auditlogEntryReport request that was used to create the report

post.description:
Generates an audit log report for the specified time period. The report includes audit information for every call made to the cloud service API during the specified time period. Creating a new audit log report overwrites a previously generated report.

After making this POST request, you need to poll for the report status by sending GET requests to /auditlogEntryReport along with the status ID obtained from the POST request. Continue polling until the report reaches a terminal status (e.g., COMPLETE or CANCELLED). When the status is COMPLETE, you can download the report as a CSV file by sending a GET request to /auditlogEntryReport/download. To learn more, see Downloading Audit Logs and Event Logs Using API.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Criteria used for generating the audit log report, such as time range, filters, pagination, etc. To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

delete.description: Cancels the request previously made to create an audit log report

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: The status ID for the report obtained from the response of the POST /auditlogEntryReport request that was used to create the report

get.description:
Downloads the most recently created audit log report based on the specified report status ID.

Before sending this request, ensure that you generate a report using POST /auditlogEntryReport and poll for report status using GET /auditlogEntryReport until the status indicates the report is completed (i.e., status is COMPLETE). To learn more, see Downloading Audit Logs and Event Logs Using API.

startTime.description: The start time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation

endTime.description: The end time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation

actionTypes.description: The action performed by the admin in the Zscaler Admin Console for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) or the action that occurred through the API

category.description: The location in the Zscaler Admin Console where the action was performed by the admin or API

subcategories.description: The subject under the selected category where the action was performed

actionResult.description: The outcome (i.e., success or failture) of an action

actionInterface.description: The interface (i.e., Admin UI or API) where the action was performed

objectName.description: The object name for the audit log entry

clientIP.description: The source IP address of the admin or the client application's IP address that executed the API

adminName.description: The admin's login ID or the internal API user (oauth-$@.) if an API action was authenticated by an external OAuth 2.0 authentication server

traceId.description: A trace ID is generated and logged for transactions associated with ZIA API requests made via Zscaler OneAPI. The trace ID helps admins correlate API transactions with the OneAPI platform and you can use the trace ID for debugging purposes.

statusId.description:
Status ID

Note: This status ID must be captured and sent in subsequent requests to poll for the report status and download the report respectively.

errorName.description: Indicates any error that occurred with report generation

markedServer.description: This attribute is for Zscaler internal use only

reportingMessage.description: Any additional information about the report generation request

startTime.description: The start time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation

endTime.description: The end time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds) in a specific time frame to be used for report generation

category.description: Filters the list based on the category of event log entries

subcategories.description: Filters the list based on the subcategories within a category of event log entries

actionResult.description: Filters the list based on the outcome of the events recorded

message.description: The search string used to match against the event log message

errorCode.description: The search string used to match against the error code in event log entries

statusCode.description: The search string used to match against the status code in event log entries
